mapper.sql: h.id, h.name, h.status, h.layout_rows, h.layout_cols, h.layout_layers, h.remark, h.create_time, h.update_time, (select count(1) from house_users members join sys_user member_users on member_users.user_id = members.user_id and member_users.status = 'ENABLED' where members.house_id = h.id and members.status = 'ENABLED') as member_count, (select count(1) from house_users owners join sys_user owner_users on owner_users.user_id = owners.user_id and owner_users.status = 'ENABLED' where owners.house_id = h.id and owners.status = 'ENABLED' and owners.role = 'OWNER') as owner_count, (select group_concat(owner_users.user_name order by owner_users.user_name separator '\n') from house_users owners join sys_user owner_users on owner_users.user_id = owners.user_id and owner_users.status = 'ENABLED' where owners.house_id = h.id and owners.status = 'ENABLED' and owners.role = 'OWNER') as owner_names_text, (select count(1) from cages c where c.house_id = h.id) as cage_count, (select count(1) from rabbits r where r.house_id = h.id) as rabbit_count
mapper.select: select count(1) from rabbit_houses h where
select from rabbit_houses h where order by h.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select from rabbit_houses h where h.id = #{houseId} and h.is_deleted = false
select count(1) from batches where house_id = #{houseId}
